description: This is a Java interface defining a repository for Score entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository. It includes custom queries for retrieving leaderboard scores and counting scores greater than a given value.

classes.name: ScoreRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Score entities, with custom queries for leaderboard and rank calculation.

methods.name: findLeaderboard
methods.description: Retrieves a leaderboard of scores ordered descending by score and ascending by creation date, with pageable support.

methods.name: countByScoreStrictlyGreater
methods.description: Counts the number of scores strictly greater than the given score, used for rank calculation.
